start.text: Welcome to The Aster. Twelve rooms, one lift that sulks, and a night manager who has not slept since 2019. I am selling it before it sells me.

choices.text: How do I make money from rooms?

rates.text: Price is the whole game. Look at the thirty-day calendar: weekends and festivals sell themselves, Tuesdays do not. Raise prices when the calendar is gold, and never leave rooms empty for pride.

Direct guests pay no commission but are few. The booking platform brings volume and takes fifteen to eighteen percent. Overbook a little, because some guests never arrive, but a walked guest costs you a room and a review.

reviews.text: Clean rooms, a friendly desk and a fair price. A room nobody cleaned cannot be sold at all, so hire housekeepers before you chase more guests.
Equipment ages. Tired rooms drag down every review until you renovate, and a renovated room is off sale while the painters work.
